about: Known client-visible Rust gaps found by client_rpc_parity.py against the pinned reference. Each case fails CI if it starts passing; remove it then. severity is for real client use: critical breaks a core flow, high breaks a feature, medium shows wrong data, low differs without visible effect.

auth.bootstrapBearerSession.reason: #37823 adds the relay:configure scope: administrative clients (owner sessions) hold it, and link proofs and relay configuration require it. Rust has no such scope, so its owner sessions lack it.

auth.sessionState.reason: #37823 adds the relay:configure scope: administrative clients (owner sessions) hold it, and link proofs and relay configuration require it. Rust has no such scope, so its owner sessions lack it.

connect.subscribeServerLifecycle.reason: The descriptor's capabilities gained previewTunnelSetting (#39415), linkThreadStream (#39406), linkClientPairing and linkPairingForLink (#39439, #40036), agentFeedback (#35871) and issueTrackerAccounts (#39179); Rust has none of these features yet, so it omits them.

vcs.review.getDiffPreview.reason: #40216 gives a diff preview's stacked sources their mergeBase, which later per-file reads pass back to skip recomputing it; Rust does not report it (it recomputes the merge base).

vcs.stacked.diff.reason: #40216 gives a diff preview's stacked sources their mergeBase, which later per-file reads pass back to skip recomputing it; Rust does not report it (it recomputes the merge base).

vcs.stacked.file.reason: #40216 gives a diff preview's stacked sources their mergeBase, which later per-file reads pass back to skip recomputing it; Rust does not report it (it recomputes the merge base).

vcs.stacked.metadata.reason: #40216 gives a diff preview's stacked sources their mergeBase, which later per-file reads pass back to skip recomputing it; Rust does not report it (it recomputes the merge base). #40211 also answers an incomplete preview's completionToken, which a later complete read passes back to reuse its tracked-only pass; Rust does not.
